_about: Tree canopy per local area (engine/fetch_canopy.py in fetch-canopy.yml, then engine/canopy.py in run.sh), from ESA WorldCover 2021 (10 m, CC BY 4.0): tree cells over land cells, water left out. Stanley Park (unit 23) has no census figures but gets a canopy share like any other unit. 'cuts' split the lens into four bands.
